The meal was absolutely wonderful and truly memorable!
Nov 2025 • Family
The restaurant had a luxurious yet cozy atmosphere, beautifully decorated and very comfortable from the moment we stepped in. Every dish was carefully prepared, full of flavor, made with fresh ingredients, and presented beautifully.
The staff were professional, friendly, and attentive throughout our meal. A small tip for future guests — it’s best to make a reservation or pre-order in advance, especially during peak dining hours, as the restaurant can get quite busy. This will help you enjoy your meal without having to wait.
Our journey through Vietnam – Ha Long – Hanoi – Sapa – Ninh Binh came to a perfect end with this excellent dining experience. Each destination had its own charm, but the food and hospitality of the Vietnamese people truly made us fall in love with this country.
From the delicious food to the elegant setting and outstanding service, everything exceeded our expectations. A perfect dining experience — we were completely satisfied and will definitely recommend this place to our friends when they visit Vietnam!
